plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a build-focused off-camp boxing plan built around two short weekly S&C sessions that support sparring instead of competing with it. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lifts so percentage work is anchored to your real baseline, and the main training starts in Week 2. The block emphasizes simple explosive work, basic strength, trunk strength, and practical upper-back work with conservative volume so you can keep quality high around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build baseline lower- and upper-body strength with simple explosive work and low enough volume to leave room for boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power work while keeping the weekly load recoverable around sparring and skill practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more toward crisp power and speed expression while maintaining enough strength to keep the force base.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Stick each landing softly and reset between reps. Jump fast and fresh, not tired.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low safe box and step down each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Pause briefly at the bottom and jump straight up.

exercises.name: 2. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few gradual sets, then build to one hard clean top set of 3-5 reps. Use your heaviest load with solid depth and posture. This establishes your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your baseline for future loading.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean top set with full depth and no form breakdown.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if your dumbbells are too light for a meaningful goblet squat test.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use the heaviest stable front-loaded option you have.

exercises.name: 3. One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Drive the elbow back and keep the torso quiet. Stop with 1-2 reps still in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if lower-back support helps you hold better position.

substitutionOptions.name: Two-Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a controlled torso angle and avoid jerking the weight.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Push the hips back, keep the dumbbells close, and feel the hamstrings. Stop with 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight or light dumbbells if equipment is limited.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a slow lower and crisp hip drive up.

exercises.name: 5. Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, squeeze glutes, and keep ribs down. End the hold before the low back sags.
